    How to use

    You need a Roblox executor. Three steps, about a minute.

    1. 01

      Copy the loader

      Hit Copy on the loadstring at the top of the page.

    2. 02

      Open a supported game

      Pick any game from the list above and load into a server.

    3. 03

      Run it

      Paste it into your executor and execute. Need one? See the Executors tab.

    Quick questions

    Is FireHub free?

    Yes. Get a key and you’re in. Plans only skip the key.

    Which games work?

    Fisch, Throw Food for Animals, Kukirin Life, Urban Reload, Survive Your Ideas, Fust Survival, The Forge, Ragdoll Soccer, Volley Bomb and Clean The Ballpit.

    How do I buy a plan?

    Open a ticket in the Discord, say which plan you want and pay.

    Which executor should I use?

    Only the official ones on the Executors tab. Any other download is probably fake.

    Get key

    Free. Runs through Linkvertise + LootLabs and a couple more. Takes like a minute.

    Get key

    1. Click Get key

      Opens the key system in a new tab.

    2. Click through the steps

      Linkvertise, LootLabs and a couple more. Just click through them.

    3. Grab your key

      The loader asks for it in game. Paste and run.

    Keys are HWID locked. One key = one device. Sharing your key = blacklist, no second chances.

    Key not working or blacklisted by mistake? Open a ticket in #tickets

    Executors

    The ones people actually use.

    What is an executor? An executor is what you use to execute a script, the ones we make. You need one to run FireHub. Pick the one for your device.

    These are the official links. Any other website or "free executor" upload is fake and probably a virus. Don't get scammed.

    Delta Official

    iOS & Android

    The most used mobile executor. Works on iPhone and Android without jailbreak.

    Android (deltaexploits.gg) iOS (deltaexploits.gg) Discord (discord.gg/deltax)

    Real Official

    Windows

    Windows executor. Download it from their official site or get help in their Discord.

    Website (projectreal.gg) Discord (discord.gg/projectreal)

    Opiumware Official

    macOS

    Mac executor. Join their official Discord to download it.

    Discord (discord.gg/opiumware)
